title: heteropogon androphilus
intro: Heteropogon androphilus, commonly known as Khasab grass, is a plant species belonging to the family Poaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may aid in reducing pain and improving overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Heteropogon androphilus include its antimicrobial and antifungal properties, which can be used to treat various infections and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic and medicinal properties.
